title: MechanicalDesign
description: Mechanical agent output: a build123d script plus the size it intends to produce, so the CAD verifier can catch scripts that do not build what they meant (PRD 6, ADR-0012).

script.description: Complete build123d script that assigns the final part to `result`. Millimetres, Z up, resting on z = 0.

intended_size_mm.title: IntendedSize
intended_size_mm.description: Bounding box the script should produce along X, Y and Z.

notes.description: One or two sentences for the build log: design choices and print orientation.
